views.markdown: **Messages, rebuilt in the iOS 26 Liquid Glass style.** Every bar, button and card gets the new glass look, plus a set of extra features you can switch on one by one.

- Glass message bar with a round **+** button that grows into an app menu (Photos, Camera, Apple Cash, stickers and more). Hold a row to reorder it, or hold **+** to jump straight to Photos.
- **Search pill** at the bottom of the conversation list with a mic, and a glass new-message button beside it. While you search, it rides on top of the keyboard.
- Glass back, Edit, name and FaceTime buttons, with a bigger contact photo and name at the top of a chat (the bigger photo has its own switch).
- Jelly bounce on every glass button.

- Glass rim on message bubbles, with a deeper blue for your iMessages.
- **Swipe right** on any message to reply. Tapback reactions slide along with the message.
- **iOS 26 photo & video viewer** with a glass video player, speed and loop.
- **Bigger audio messages** that play out loud on the speaker.

- New design with glass Back and Edit, three round call / video / mail buttons and tabs: **Info, Backgrounds, Photos, Links, Documents, Collaboration**. Tabs only show up when the chat has something in them.
- **Backgrounds** for each chat: None, Photo, Color, Sky, Water, Aurora, Shuffle (up to 5 photos) or Live Photo (hold to play). Pull up past the last message to see the whole background.
- **Bubble Colors**: pick colors or gradients for your bubbles and theirs.

views.title: Custom features (off until you turn them on)

views.markdown:
Open them from the glass button at the top right of the conversation list.

- **Chat Lock**: Face ID before a chat opens, with its preview hidden on the list. Choose how long it stays unlocked.
- **Contact Frames**: animated frames around up to 3 people's photos, or make your own from any 3 emojis with a ring color and animation.
- **3D Reactions**: glossy 3D heart, thumbs, HA HA, !! and ? tapbacks.
- **Keyword Effects**: emoji rain for "love you", "congrats", "lol", "good night" and more.
- **Live Read Time**: "Read 2m ago" that keeps counting.
- **Spelling Fix**: a glass "Fix typos" chip above the message box, with your own list of ignored words.
- **Mood Detection**: a small mood pill under their name, worked out on your phone.
- **Saved Messages** and **Message Reminders**: hold a message to save it or get reminded about it later.

views.text: Made by nano · iPhone 13 Pro Max tested

views.markdown:
- Music and other files open in Apple's own viewer again
- Bug fixes

- **iOS 26 photo & video viewer**: glass X, a big play button with 10 second skips, a glass time bar, a glass ... panel with playback speed and loop, and glass save and share buttons
- **Bigger audio messages** with a big play button and a long waveform
- **Audio messages play on the speaker** instead of the earpiece (still switches to the earpiece at your ear)
- **FaceTime button** opens one glass panel with FaceTime Audio and Video
- **Contact page**: plain black background and round press highlights on call, video and mail
- **Redesigned settings** with a header and a live preview phone that follows your switches
- **Springy Messages26 sheet**: rows spring in and react when you flip them
- Bug fixes

- New **iOS 26 Contact Photo** switch: keep the glass back and FaceTime buttons with the normal small photo and name
- Messages26 icon in its settings

- The contact name now always shows in its glass capsule at the top of a chat
- Name and capsule sit a little lower under the photo
- The old small name no longer peeks out above the capsule
- Smoother on older iPhones (8, 8 Plus, X)
